comments.text: After this roundabout most car will head to the small city of Liquica or straight to the border.

comments.text: You can reach this spot with the microlet number 10 or 11 (its the terminus of both lines, 25cts). Quite a lot of shared taxis, tuk tuk and people hanging around. Good idea to walk a bit further.
